hook.name: HookrModularHookV6Wth
hook.description: A modular Uniswap v4 hook that applies a dynamic LP fee and performs on-chain arbitrage recapture (MEV correction) on every qualifying swap by dispatching a nested correction swap through a pool-configured executor. Swap accounting is delegated via delegatecall to an immutable, codehash-verified accounting kernel; trusted routers may supply signed hookData for enriched payer/recipient routing.
